reason: Passing a function the page calls back, through the evaluation's exposeFunctions option. Strider's evaluation arguments cross by value, and a function inside an argument is left out (one on its own is refused as NotSerializable), so the page has no callback to call; Strider has no exposeFunction or exposeBinding either

Passing a function the page calls back to page.evaluateHandle, through exposeFunctions, which Strider's evaluateHandle doesn't take: its arguments cross by value, and a function inside an argument is left out, and one on its own is refused

Passing a function the frame's script calls back, through exposeFunctions on Frame.evaluate. Strider has no frame-level evaluation with a callback, and a function inside an evaluation's argument is left out (one on its own is refused as NotSerializable)

Passing a function the page calls back to a handle's evaluate, through exposeFunctions. Strider's handle evaluate takes by-value arguments only, and a function inside an argument is left out (one on its own is refused as NotSerializable)

Passing a function the element's script calls back, through exposeFunctions on Locator.evaluate. Strider's locator evaluate takes by-value arguments only, and a function inside an argument is left out (one on its own is refused as NotSerializable)

Passing a function the element's script calls back to a locator's evaluateHandle, through exposeFunctions. Strider's locator evaluateHandle takes by-value arguments only, and a function inside an argument is left out (one on its own is refused as NotSerializable)
